data.title: Man pleads guilty to orchestrating $240 million bitcoin theft from DC resident
data.description: A 22-year-old man from Singapore has pleaded guilty to teaming up with friends to steal nearly a quarter-billion dollars in bitcoin from a Washington, D.C., resident and then embarking on a wild spending spree with the laundered proceeds
data.author: ABC News
